==Rewards== Players are awarded Farming experience, as well as 1 point for every third fruit deposited to spend in [[Farmer Gricoller's Rewards]] shop. To earn points, players must deposit harvested fruits in sacks. The amount of experience and points awarded depends on how many fruits are deposited. As many as 10,000 fruits can be harvested and deposited (in batches of up to 100) in a single instance. If the sack is partially full and the player attempts to deposit while having enough fruits in their inventory to surpass the sack's limit of 100, the player will deposit enough to fill the sack, and the sack will become empty again. Players receive bonus experience of 250 times the harvest experience rate when depositing the 75th fruit—1,500, 3,500, or 5,750 experience for [[Golovanova fruit|Golovanova]], [[Bologano fruit|Bologano]], and [[Logavano fruit|Logavano]] respectively. Additionally, double experience is awarded for the 75th through 100th fruit added to the sack, and 2 bonus points are awarded to players when they add the 100th fruit. Players can only possess a maximum of 16,000 points. Fruits deposited after this cap has been reached will still award Farming experience, but no points. To purchase all [[Tithe Farm#Reward shop|collectible items]] ([[Farmer's outfit|outfit]], farming tools, and Auto-weed), a player would need 1,150 points, which comes out to 3,290 fruits if consistently depositing in batches of 100. Gathering 3,300 fruits with the [[Tithe Farm/Strategies#25x4 method|25x4 method]] takes roughly 10.5 hours.Harvesting 100 fruits with the 25x4 method takes roughly 19 minutes{{Reflist|group=r}}{{Tithe Farm Points}} ===Reward shop=== [[File:Farmer Gricoller's Rewards interface.png|thumb|250x250px|The rewards interface.]] {{Main|Farmer Gricoller's Rewards}} Multiple pieces of clothing can be purchased.
